# Global Energy Map documentation

> Index of the documentation for Global Energy Map, an open model of oil and gas dependency, with links to the guides, runbooks and dated records.

The Markdown files are the source of truth.
Read AGENTS.md first for conventions.

## Documents

- [01 Overview](01-overview.md): What Global Energy Map is, the ideas behind it, what is in and out of scope, and where the other documents live.
- [02 Spike: energy-price and flow context through OpenBB ODP](02-odp-energy-context-spike.md): A one-day trial of OpenBB's Open Data Platform (V5, free providers) as a source of price, production, stock and chokepoint-traffic context for the map — what worked, each provider's licence, refresh cadence, and the recommendation not to merge it as is.

## Machine-readable data

- [Manifest](data/manifest.json): every document with its metadata, dependencies and section anchors
- [Glossary](data/glossary.json): terms and definitions

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conventions for agents reading or editing these documents
- [index.html](index.html): all documents as one static page for people
